intro: In writing, the long participle that appears after the name usually forms a descriptive paragraph separated by commas.

bloques.titulo: In writing, the long participle that appears after the name usually forms a descriptive paragraph separated by commas.
texto: In writing, the long participle that appears after the name usually forms a descriptive paragraph separated by commas.
If it precedes the name, it is usually part of the nominal group and is not separated in the same way: опубликованная вчера статья.

frases.ru: Отчёт, подготовленный экспертами, содержит новые данные.
frases.es: El informe, preparado por expertos, contiene nuevos datos.
frases.en: The report, prepared by experts, contains new data.

frases.ru: Подписанный вчера договор вступил в силу.
frases.es: El contrato firmado ayer entró en vigor.
frases.en: The contract signed yesterday came into force.
